step1_analysis.description: A clocked sense amplifier (StrongARM latch variant) used in a current-mode transceiver receiver. It resolves small differential input signals into full CMOS logic levels during the evaluate phase and precharges the output nodes during the clock low phase.

paper_reference.title: A 95fJ/b Current-Mode Transceiver for 10mm On-Chip Interconnect

energy_per_operation.description: Energy consumed per bit/operation by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Energy = VDD * I_avg * T_cycle. For the sense amp alone at 1.8V, I_avg ~ 10-20uA at 500MHz, yielding ~18-36fJ. The 95fJ reported includes the full TX and TIA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and isolating the sense amplifier from the full transceiver.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on transistor mismatch (A_vt) and thermal noise. In 1.8V SKY130, Vth mismatch is typically higher than in 65nm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Larger feature sizes and higher supply in SKY130 typically result in slightly worse sensitivity without offset calibration.

delay.description: Clock-to-Q delay of the sense amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Time to discharge internal nodes and flip the latch. T ~ C * V / I. C ~ 10fF, V ~ 0.9V, I ~ 100uA -> ~90ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard delay for a StrongARM-style latch in 130nm.
This metric belongs to the TIA stage mentioned in the paper, not the extracted sense amplifier.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure the clock-to-Q delay and energy per operation of the sense amplifier. A missing precharge PMOS for N0 is added to correct an apparent extraction error where XM13's gate was tied to VDD.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Sense Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u

* DUT Instantiation
XM1 N0 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N4 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 GND LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 N4 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N6 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N6 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N0 N6 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N5 LABEL_NET_4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N0 VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

* Fix for missing precharge on N0 (XM13 gate likely mis-extracted as VDD)
XMPRE N0 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5u w=5u

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCLK N4 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 1n 2n)
VCLK2 LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 1n 2n)
VINP LABEL_NET_0 0 1.0
VINN LABEL_NET_4 0 0.8
VREF LABEL_NET_3 0 0
VDUM LABEL_NET_1 0 0

* Load Capacitors
C1 N0 0 10f
C2 N6 0 10f

* Analysis
.control
tran 10p 5n
* Measure delay from CLK rising to N6 falling (since VINP > VINN)
meas tran delay_N6 trig v(N4) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N6) val=0.9 fall=1
* Measure average current from VDD over one full clock cycle (1n to 3n)
meas tran i_vdd avg i(VVDD) from=1n to=3n
* Calculate energy per operation (Power * Period)
let energy_per_op = -i_vdd * 1.8 * 2e-9
print delay_N6 energy_per_op
quit
.endc
